request.sql:
select order_id, customer_id, ordered_at, subtotal, tax_paid, order_total
from ANALYTICS_DB.prod.stg_orders

where ordered_at > (select coalesce(max(ordered_at), '1900-01-01') from ANALYTICS_DB.prod.orders_incremental)

query_dependencies.name: "ANALYTICS_DB"."PROD"."STG_ORDERS"
query_dependencies.query:
create or replace view STG_ORDERS(
	ORDER_ID,
	LOCATION_ID,
	CUSTOMER_ID,
	SUBTOTAL_CENTS,
	TAX_PAID_CENTS,
	ORDER_TOTAL_CENTS,
	SUBTOTAL,
	TAX_PAID,
	ORDER_TOTAL,
	ORDERED_AT
) as (
    with

source as (

    select * from ANALYTICS_DB.raw.raw_orders

),

renamed as (

    select

        ----------  ids
        id as order_id,
        store_id as location_id,
        customer as customer_id,

        ---------- numerics
        subtotal as subtotal_cents,
        tax_paid as tax_paid_cents,
        order_total as order_total_cents,
        (subtotal / 100)::numeric(16, 2) as subtotal,
        (tax_paid / 100)::numeric(16, 2) as tax_paid,
        (order_total / 100)::numeric(16, 2) as order_total,

        ---------- timestamps
        date_trunc('day', ordered_at) as ordered_at

    from source

)

select * from renamed
  )
